hooks.command: f=$(python3 -c "import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get('file_path',''))" 2>/dev/null); if echo "$f" | grep -qE '(^|/)\.(env)([^/]|$)'; then echo 'Blocked: .env files must be edited manually to protect AWS credentials.' >&2; exit 2; fi

f=$(python3 -c "import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get('file_path',''))" 2>/dev/null); if echo "$f" | grep -q 'backend/src/.*\.js$'; then cd /home/sico/Code/MiniJira && npx --prefix backend eslint --fix "$f" 2>&1 | tail -5; elif echo "$f" | grep -qE 'frontend/src/.*\.(js|jsx)$'; then cd /home/sico/Code/MiniJira && npx --prefix frontend eslint --fix "$f" 2>&1 | tail -5; fi; exit 0
